shell.menuDescription: Switch organization or go to any part of Watermark Pro.

theme.system: Theme: follows system. Switch to light

login.title: Welcome back
login.verifyBody: We sent a verification link to {{email}}.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: A verification link will be sent to your email.
signup.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A few unrelated words work well.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send a reset link if an account exists.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If {{email}} belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This reset link is not valid
resetPassword.invalidBody: It may have expired or already been used.

library.label: Library
library.body: Design text, symbol and logo watermarks once and keep them as presets.

editor.label: Editor
editor.body: Watermark one photo by hand: place, crop, resize and export.

bulk.label: Bulk
bulk.body: Apply a preset to a whole shoot and download the results as a ZIP.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.body: Browse what the team has saved, then share albums with a link.

dashboard.auditDescription: Every membership and organization change is recorded with who did it and when.

library.orgRequired: Create or join an organization to build a watermark library.
library.heading: Watermark library
library.description: Presets shared by everyone in {{name}}. Apply them one at a time or in bulk.
library.empty: No presets yet. A preset combines a mark (text, symbol or logo) with placement, contrast and style settings.
library.exportLogoTypeError: A logo has an image type that cannot be exported.
library.exportMissingLogoError: A preset refers to a logo that is no longer in the library.

designer.nameError: Give the preset a name of up to 60 characters.
designer.readOnlyHint: Your role can view presets but not change them.
designer.notAnImage: That file is not an image the browser can read.

text.label: Text
text.hint: Up to {{max}} characters on up to {{lines}} lines. Use "Insert detail" for tokens like the date or camera, filled in per photo. {location} prints the photo's GPS position on the picture.

qr.hint: A link, usually. Up to {{max}} characters; the code is always dark on a light field so it scans.

placement.smartDescription: Analyses each photo and picks the calmest corner
placement.cornerDescription: Fixed position relative to the edges
placement.customDescription: Exact position as a fraction of the photo
placement.randomDescription: A different spot per photo; harder to auto-remove
placement.smartHint: The engine scores every corner and edge for detail, contrast and subject, then places the mark where it is legible and least intrusive.
placement.randomHint: Each photo gets a random corner, nudged by up to the jitter below. The same photo always lands in the same place.

style.autoDescription: Light or dark ink chosen per photo
style.colourDescription: An ink colour of your own
style.autoHint: Ink switches between light and dark to suit the area under the mark, and an outline is added only when the background is too close in tone.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.choosePhoto: Choose a photo to preview on
preview.alt: Watermark preview on the subject photo
preview.chooseLogo: Choose or upload a logo to see the preview.

logo.empty: No logos yet. Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP with a transparent background for best results.
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to {{max}} MB, or a drawn signature.
logo.tooLarge: Logos must be {{max}} MB or smaller.

prepare.title: Prepare “{{name}}”
prepare.description: Optionally clear a flat background and trim empty edges, then upload it as a transparent PNG.

signature.description: Sign with a finger, a pen or the mouse. It is saved as a transparent logo in the library, cropped to the ink.

editor.orgRequired: Create or join an organization to use the editor.
editor.heading: Editor
editor.description: Watermark one photo: pick a preset, place it by hand if you like, crop, resize and download. Nothing leaves your browser.
editor.choosePresetHint: Choose a preset to place a watermark. Drop a photo anywhere on the canvas.
editor.notAnImage: That file is not an image the browser can read.

watermark.adjusted: Adjusted for this photo; the library preset is unchanged.

crop.area: Crop area. Drag to move; arrow keys nudge, Shift for larger steps.

strip.label: Strip
strip.help: No camera data, no location. Safest for sharing.

keepExceptLocation.label: Keep except location
keepExceptLocation.help: Camera, lens and capture time stay; GPS is removed.

keep.label: Keep everything
keep.help: Including the GPS position, if the photo has one.

export.choosePng: Choose PNG to hide a message in the pixels.
export.tooLong: Too long for a {{width}}×{{height}} photo (fits {{capacity}} bytes).
export.invisibleHint: Hidden in the pixels and readable under Verify. Survives PNG only.
export.renderNote: {{width}} × {{height}} px{{lossless}}. Rendered in your browser at full resolution{{share}}.
export.shareClause: ; Share sends it to Photos, Messages or any app on this device

mark.position: Watermark position. Drag to move (it snaps to the margins, thirds and centre; hold Alt to place it freely), pinch to resize, twist to rotate; arrow keys nudge, plus and minus resize, square brackets rotate.

bulk.orgRequired: Create or join an organization to watermark in bulk.
bulk.heading: Bulk watermarking
bulk.description: Apply one preset to a whole shoot. Photos are processed in parallel in your browser and downloaded as a ZIP or one by one.
bulk.emptyHint: to apply it to a batch.
bulk.dropHint: Drop photos or a folder here, or
bulk.capacity_one: Up to {{max}} photos per batch. Processing happens in your browser using {{count}} worker.
bulk.capacity_other: Up to {{max}} photos per batch. Processing happens in your browser using {{count}} workers.
bulk.importErrorTitle: Could not import from the cloud
bulk.presetHint: Tick one or more; they are applied in the order ticked, later ones over earlier ones.
bulk.choosePng: Choose PNG to hide a message in every photo.

names.mustProduceName: The pattern must produce a name.

bulk.someSaved: {{failed}} could not be saved (storage quota or limits). The rest are in the <galleryLink>gallery</galleryLink>.
bulk.privacyNote: Smart placement and auto contrast are worked out for every photo separately. Nothing is uploaded.

watch.label: Watch a folder
watch.hint: Pick an input and an output folder; new photos dropped into the input are watermarked with the ticked presets and written to the output. Runs only while this page is open.

gallery.orgRequired: Create or join an organization to keep a gallery.
gallery.heading: Gallery
gallery.description: Watermarked photos saved by {{name}}. Search, filter by preset, download or delete.
gallery.empty: No photos yet. Save one from the editor or a whole batch from the bulk tool.
gallery.deleteConfirmBody: The files and thumbnails are removed from storage. This cannot be undone.
gallery.shareDescription: Anyone with the link can view and download these photos until it expires or you revoke it.
gallery.title: Title

shares.orgRequired: Create or join an organization to share photos.
shares.noPermission: Your role does not include sharing.
shares.heading: Shares
shares.description: Links that let people outside {{name}} view and download selected photos. Revoking a link stops it immediately.
shares.empty: No links yet. Select photos in the gallery and choose Share.

admin.heading: Administration
admin.description: Every user and organization on this deployment. Actions here are recorded in the audit trail.
admin.onlyAdmins: Only platform administrators can open this page.
admin.banConfirmBody: Their sessions end now and they cannot sign in until unbanned. The reason is shown to them and kept in the audit trail.
admin.auditErrorTitle: Could not load the audit trail
admin.auditCaption: Audit entries across all organizations, newest first

members.orgRequired: Create or join an organization to manage members.
members.heading: Members
members.description: People in {{name}} and what they can do.

audit.heading: Audit log
audit.description: The most recent changes in {{name}}. Owners and admins can view this page.
audit.loadErrorTitle: Could not load the audit log
audit.noAccess: Your role does not include audit access.

organizations.description: Organizations hold your watermarks, photos and team. You will be its owner.
organizations.createFailed: The organization could not be created.
organizations.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Used in links and must be unique.

url.title: Import from a link
url.description: Paste the address of an image on the web. We fetch it and add it here.

onedrive.title: Import from OneDrive
onedrive.description: Sign in to Microsoft, then choose photos to add.

video.orgRequired: Create or join an organization to watermark video.
video.heading: Video watermarking
video.description: Apply a preset to a whole video. Every frame is watermarked in your browser and the audio is kept; nothing is uploaded.
video.unsupportedTitle: Video is not supported in this browser
video.unsupportedBody: Your browser cannot encode video. Chrome, Edge or Safari 17 and later can.
video.emptyHint: to apply it to a video.
video.formatsHint: MP4, WebM or MOV. Everything happens in your browser; nothing is uploaded, and the gallery does not take videos yet.
video.choosePresetPreview: Choose a preset to preview the watermark on a frame.
video.fixedPlacementNote: The watermark keeps one fixed placement for the whole video. Audio is copied through when it fits the output, otherwise re-encoded.
video.previewAlt: The watermark on a frame of the video

documents.orgRequired: Create or join an organization to watermark documents.
documents.heading: Documents
documents.description: Stamp a preset onto every page of a PDF. Files are processed in your browser and downloaded one by one or as a ZIP.
documents.filesHint: Up to {{max}} files, {{size}} each. Every page is watermarked in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
documents.skipped_one: {{count}} file skipped: not a PDF or over {{max}}.
documents.skipped_other: {{count}} files skipped: not a PDF or over {{max}}.
documents.presetHint: Tick one or more; they are drawn in the order ticked, later ones over earlier ones.
documents.smartPlacementHint: Smart placement is for photos; choose a corner or a custom position for documents.
documents.savedAsHint: Each document is saved as {name}-watermarked.pdf. Encrypted PDFs are refused.

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.description: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. It expires in one hour.
checkEmail.resent: A new verification link is on its way.

errors.fallback: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.
